post.description:
The factor report of a backtested portfolio tree (kept in memory, never stored).

The tree is flattened to its instruments with a weight above 0. Prices come from Yahoo
(adjusted close), the weights drift and reset to target at each month-end, and the net daily
returns go through the same factor analysis as a ticker. The unallocated weight is held in
USD cash, which earns the risk-free rate. Only instruments with a weight above 0 limit the
window. The model defaults to ff6; a range or dates cut the analysis sample.

burn_in_rows.title: Burn In Rows
burn_in_rows.description: Rows of the initial OLS fit (21).

training_rows.title: Training Rows
training_rows.description: Rows of the first estimate and first stamp (504).

dates.title: Dates
dates.description: Shared date axis: every row of the analysis sample.

betas.title: Betas
betas.description: Filtered beta per factor (display names), aligned with ``dates``.

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: Per factor, at the last date.

KalmanBetaSeries.title: KalmanBetaSeries
KalmanBetaSeries.description:
Filtered (point-in-time) Kalman betas per date, with model-based bands (spec KB0.1).

Status values (spec KB8.3): ``ok``; ``insufficient_data`` when the sample has fewer than 504
rows; ``failed`` when the first 21 rows do not identify the model (``singular_burn_in``) or a
factor covariance is singular (``singular_factor_covariance``). The reason of a not-ok
section names the code in parentheses.

KalmanLatest.title: KalmanLatest
KalmanLatest.description: The filtered beta of one factor at the last date, with its model standard deviation.

estimated_through.title: Estimated Through
estimated_through.description: Date of the last row used (row ``rows``).

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Rows ``1 .. rows`` of the sample were used.

lam.title: Lam
lam.description: Signal-to-noise ratio lambda (0: no drift detected).

lam_at_bound.title: Lam At Bound
lam_at_bound.description: 'zero' when lambda is 0, 'upper' at the largest grid value 1e-2, else 'none'.

resid_var.title: Resid Var
resid_var.description: Residual variance R_hat, decimal^2 per day.

resid_vol_ann.title: Resid Vol Ann
resid_vol_ann.description: sqrt(252 R_hat): residual volatility a year.

w_eq.title: W Eq
w_eq.description: Equivalent rolling window 2 / sqrt(lambda) in rows; null when lambda is 0.

KalmanVintage.title: KalmanVintage
KalmanVintage.description:
Hyperparameters of one yearly re-estimate (spec KB2.4). Vintage ``j`` uses rows
``1 .. rows`` only and supplies the stamps from ``valid_from`` to ``valid_to``.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

LeadLagSection.title: LeadLagSection
LeadLagSection.description: Timing-adjusted betas: same-day plus previous- and next-day factor coefficients (LL0.1).

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: A ticker, "RF" for the risk-free rate, or null when there is no proxy yet.

note.title: Note
note.description: The caveat a reader should see with the proxy.

first_date.title: First Date
first_date.description: First daily price date of the proxy.

hedge_eur.title: Hedge Eur
hedge_eur.description: True for a bond line with only US-dollar underlying: the EUR view hedges it to euros (its return above US cash, plus euro cash).

multi_currency.title: Multi Currency
multi_currency.description: True for a bond fund that holds several currencies: the EUR view leaves it unhedged and says so.

LibraryLine.title: LibraryLine
LibraryLine.description: One sub-asset class of the owner's Asset Class Library and the proxy that stands for it.

role.title: Role
role.description: What it feeds, for example "TERM = IEF minus RF".

first_date.title: First Date
first_date.description: First price date; None when not fetched.

MacroLeg.title: MacroLeg
MacroLeg.description: One fund behind a factor, with its first price date.

label.title: Label
label.description: Plain label: Market, Rates, Credit, Commodities, Inflation, US dollar.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: How the factor is built, for example "IEF minus RF".

note.title: Note
note.description: Caveat on the factor, for example the DEF label.

beta.title: Beta
beta.description: Raw beta (the summed same-day and lag beta for the dollar).

se.title: Se
se.description: Newey-West HAC standard error of beta.

ci_low.title: Ci Low
ci_low.description: Lower end of the 95% interval, beta - q * se.

ci_high.title: Ci High
ci_high.description: Upper end of the 95% interval, beta + q * se.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Reliable when the Benjamini-Hochberg rule of the headline betas rejects zero across the factors of this regression.

vif.title: Vif
vif.description: Variance inflation factor among the factors.

beta_same_day.title: Beta Same Day
beta_same_day.description: Dollar row of a daily subject: the same-day part of the summed beta.

beta_lag.title: Beta Lag
beta_lag.description: Dollar row of a daily subject: the previous-day part of the summed beta.

MacroRow.title: MacroRow
MacroRow.description: One factor of the macro regression.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

model_note.title: Model Note
model_note.description: Fixed note: separate regression, raw betas, not alpha.

n_sample.title: N Sample
n_sample.description: Rows of the analysis sample before the funds.

t_reference.title: T Reference
t_reference.description: Reference distribution of the p-values; None when not computed.

adj_r2.title: Adj R2
adj_r2.description: Adjusted R squared of the regression.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Market, rates, credit, commodities, inflation, dollar.

correlation_codes.title: Correlation Codes
correlation_codes.description: Factors of the correlation matrix, in row and column order.

legs.title: Legs
legs.description: The funds behind the factors, with first dates.

window_limited_by.title: Window Limited By
window_limited_by.description: The fund whose first date starts the window, when it is later than the subject's own start; None otherwise.

usd_included.title: Usd Included
usd_included.description: False when the dollar index was unavailable.

usd_note.title: Usd Note
usd_note.description: Why the dollar row is missing, or a note on the dollar series.

usd_lag_note.title: Usd Lag Note
usd_lag_note.description: Explains the summed dollar beta of a daily subject; None for monthly.

MacroSection.title: MacroSection
MacroSection.description: The macro sensitivities: one row per factor, one regression.

reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Standard footnotes that apply (keys of M0.9).

n_rows_unused.title: N Rows Unused
n_rows_unused.description: Rows after the last full block (0-4).

sigma_e_annual.title: Sigma E Annual
sigma_e_annual.description: sqrt(252 / horizon) x sd of residuals.

MultiDayRegression.title: MultiDayRegression
MultiDayRegression.description: Regression on sums over non-overlapping 5-day blocks (M3.6); only when the gate fired.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

NonOverlappingAlpha.title: NonOverlappingAlpha
NonOverlappingAlpha.description: Family FR1 (R5.2): disjoint 252-row windows tiled from the end of S.

max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
max_drawdown.description: Deepest fall from a running peak; 0 when the path never fell.

peak_date.title: Peak Date
peak_date.description: None when there was no drawdown.

recovery_date.title: Recovery Date
recovery_date.description: None when not recovered or no drawdown.

days_peak_to_trough.title: Days Peak To Trough
days_peak_to_trough.description: Periods from peak to trough (trading days, or months when subject.periods = 12); None when there was no drawdown.

days_trough_to_recovery.title: Days Trough To Recovery
days_trough_to_recovery.description: Periods from trough to recovery (trading days, or months when subject.periods = 12); None when not recovered or no drawdown.

episodes.title: Episodes
episodes.description: Up to five distinct, non-overlapping episodes, deepest first; the first equals the maximum drawdown. Empty when there was no drawdown.

series.description: Drawdown at each analysed date (trading days, or month-ends when subject.periods = 12).

PerformanceDrawdown.title: PerformanceDrawdown
PerformanceDrawdown.description: Maximum drawdown and the deepest episodes.

n_days.title: N Days
n_days.description: Periods of the analysed sample (trading days, or months when subject.periods = 12).

years.title: Years
years.description: n_days / P, with P the observations a year (252, or subject.periods).

cagr.title: Cagr
cagr.description: Compound annual growth rate: prod(1 + r)^(P / n) - 1, with P the observations a year (252, or subject.periods).

mean_return_annual.title: Mean Return Annual
mean_return_annual.description: Arithmetic mean of the periodic returns times P (252, or subject.periods); ignores compounding.

PerformanceReturns.title: PerformanceReturns
PerformanceReturns.description: Growth of the subject over the window (simple total returns per period, M1.3).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

volatility_annual.title: Volatility Annual
volatility_annual.description: sqrt(P) x sample sd (ddof 1) of the periodic simple returns, with P the observations a year (252, or subject.periods).

PerformanceSection.title: PerformanceSection
PerformanceSection.description:
Historical return, volatility, Sharpe ratio and maximum drawdown of the analysed subject.

Descriptive and in-sample: it says what happened over the window, not what will happen.
Statuses: ``ok``; ``insufficient_data`` (fewer than 60 observations); ``failed``.

ratio_annual.title: Ratio Annual
ratio_annual.description: sqrt(P) x mean(excess) / sd(excess), ddof 1, with P the observations a year (252, or subject.periods); None when the excess returns do not vary (the ratio is not defined).

ratio_daily.title: Ratio Daily
ratio_daily.description: Ratio per period, mean(excess) / sd(excess): per trading day, or per month when subject.periods = 12 (the name is kept for compatibility); None as above.

mean_excess_annual.title: Mean Excess Annual
mean_excess_annual.description: P x mean of the periodic excess returns (P = 252, or subject.periods).

sharpe_se_iid.title: Sharpe Se Iid
sharpe_se_iid.description: Approximate standard error of the annual ratio, sqrt(P) x sqrt((1 + ratio_daily^2 / 2) / n) (Lo 2002), P = 252 or subject.periods. Assumes independent, identically distributed returns.

ci_includes_zero.title: Ci Includes Zero
ci_includes_zero.description: True when the 95% interval contains 0; None when the ratio is not defined.

PerformanceSharpe.title: PerformanceSharpe
PerformanceSharpe.description: Sharpe ratio of the periodic excess returns (subject return minus the factor file's RF).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

window_start.title: Window Start
window_start.description: First day with a portfolio return.

window_end.title: Window End
window_end.description: Last day with a portfolio return.

start_limited_by.title: Start Limited By
start_limited_by.description: Instruments whose history starts latest and so set the window start (several on a tie).

end_limited_by.title: End Limited By
end_limited_by.description: Instruments whose history ends earliest and so set the window end. USD cash ends with the factor file, so it can set the end.

n_instruments.title: N Instruments
n_instruments.description: Instruments with a target weight above 0.

n_rebalances.title: N Rebalances
n_rebalances.description: Month-end closes at which the weights were reset to target.

n_dates_dropped.title: N Dates Dropped
n_dates_dropped.description: Trading days inside the window on which at least one instrument had no price. They are skipped for all instruments.

data_note.title: Data Note
data_note.description: Plain-words note on those skipped days; None when there were none.

cost_bps.title: Cost Bps
cost_bps.description: Cost per unit of turnover, basis points.

total_cost.title: Total Cost
total_cost.description: Sum over the window of the cost paid at each rebalance, as a fraction of the portfolio value at that close.

average_turnover.title: Average Turnover
average_turnover.description: Mean one-way turnover of a rebalance, as a fraction of the portfolio; 0 when there was no rebalance.

unallocated_weight.title: Unallocated Weight
unallocated_weight.description: Weight left over by the targets; held in USD cash, or as euro cash when unallocated_currency says so.

unallocated_currency.title: Unallocated Currency
unallocated_currency.description: EUR when the unallocated weight is held as euro cash (the EUR view); absent (not null) in the USD view, where it is held in USD cash.

survivorship_note.title: Survivorship Note
survivorship_note.description: Fixed warning carried by every backtest.

PortfolioBacktestSection.title: PortfolioBacktestSection
PortfolioBacktestSection.description: The backtest behind a portfolio report. Status is always ``ok`` when the section exists.

reference_currency.title: Reference Currency
reference_currency.description: Currency of the backtest and of every figure of the report; left out of the JSON when USD.

factor_set.title: Factor Set
factor_set.description: Regional Fama-French factor set of the report: us (default) or europe (Developed Europe, in US dollars); left out of the JSON when us.

PortfolioTree.title: PortfolioTree
PortfolioTree.description: A named portfolio: the tree and the cost of a rebalance.

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: Beta size the years-to-detect figure asks about.

extra_years_to_detect_delta.title: Extra Years To Detect Delta
extra_years_to_detect_delta.description: More years of similar data needed to detect delta; null for Mkt-RF.

PowerStatement.title: PowerStatement
PowerStatement.description: What the test behind the tags can detect for one factor (SB5).

factor_coverage_end.title: Factor Coverage End
factor_coverage_end.description: Last date with factor data; later points are drawn muted.

PriceSeries.title: PriceSeries
PriceSeries.description: Adjusted close for charting only (never used for regression here).

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of the step in this run, from 1.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of steps in this run.

ProgressStep.title: ProgressStep
ProgressStep.description: Data of an ``event: step`` of a ``.../stream`` endpoint: a step the run has reached.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

label.description: Index the proxy stands in for, for example 'MSCI Europe'.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Yahoo ticker of the proxy fund, for example 'IEUR'.

n_days.description: Days common to the analysis sample and the proxy.

hac_lags.title: Hac Lags
hac_lags.description: Newey-West lags of both regressions; null if none.

n_not_in_benchmark.title: N Not In Benchmark
n_not_in_benchmark.description: Rows of the analysis sample with no usable proxy return.

first_date.title: First Date
first_date.description: First date of the proxy price history used; null if there is none.

last_date.title: Last Date
last_date.description: Last date of the proxy price history used; null if there is none.

note.title: Note
note.description: Set when the proxy refresh failed: where the cached history ends, or why there is none.

audit_warnings.title: Audit Warnings
audit_warnings.description: Warnings of the proxy price audit (M1.4).

benchmark.description: Against the proxy fund, excess of RF.

us_market.description: Against the US market, same days.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: Proxy beta against the US market beta: about_the_same when the two 95% intervals overlap, otherwise higher or lower (a reading of the intervals, not a test).

comparison_text.title: Comparison Text
comparison_text.description: The plain reading of the comparison.

ProxyBeta.title: ProxyBeta
ProxyBeta.description:
The quick beta against one more proxy (Europe: IEUR), with its own status.

Holds what the ACWI fields of ``WorldBetaSection`` hold, for one proxy: the beta against the
proxy and against the US market on the same days, the comparison, the days and the price
history it rests on. It answers for its own numbers: a block that is not ``ok`` has no fit.

labels.description: Standard footnotes that apply (keys of M0.9).

noise_share.title: Noise Share
noise_share.description: min(1, -2 x lag-1 autocorrelation): share of residual variance that is a price error reversing the next day, under the simple model of M3.6.

message.title: Message
message.description: The caveat shown in the report when fired.

QualityGate.title: QualityGate
QualityGate.description: Residual quality gate for non-synchronous prices (M3.6).

RangeOption.title: RangeOption
RangeOption.description: One range preset for one ticker; ``reason`` is None exactly when ``available``.

alpha_tag.description: 'reliable' iff alpha_p < 0.05 (single test); when the quality gate fired, also the 5-day alpha p must be below 0.05 (M3.6).

alpha_sentence.title: Alpha Sentence
alpha_sentence.description: Explanation shown when |alpha| >= 3% a year but p >= 0.05 (M3.2).

sigma_e_annual.description: Residual volatility, sqrt(P) x sd, P = 252 or subject.periods.

bh_family_size.description: Number of betas in the BH family (F1).

condition_number.description: sqrt(max/min eigenvalue) of the 5x5 factor correlation matrix over the sample (M3.4). Not statsmodels' results.condition_number, which is computed on the raw design including the constant and is large even for uncorrelated daily factors.

Regression.description: Full-sample excess-return regression ``y = alpha + sum(b_i f_i) + e`` (M3).

label.description: Display name: the fund or portfolio name, or the ticker.

periods.title: Periods
periods.description: Observations a year used to annualise: 252 for daily data, 12 for monthly.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the returns come from, e.g. 'upload'.

gross_net.title: Gross Net
gross_net.description: Whether the returns are before or after fees; None: unknown.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of the returns (USD only for now); None: unknown.

SubjectInfo.title: SubjectInfo
SubjectInfo.description:
What the report is about when it is not a daily ticker (written only for those subjects).

Counts that the report names in days (``n_days``, ``days_peak_to_trough``) are counts of
observations at ``frequency``: months for a monthly subject.

low.title: Low
low.description: Lower end of the band, as a fraction of value.

high.title: High
high.description: Upper end of the band, as a fraction of value.

resamples.title: Resamples
resamples.description: Bootstrap resamples behind the band (those inside the valid range).

TailBand.title: TailBand
TailBand.description: A percentile bootstrap band around one figure.

level.title: Level
level.description: Confidence level: 0.99 for VaR and 0.975 for CVaR; monthly series also 0.95.

value.title: Value
value.description: Loss as a positive fraction of value; None when the figure is not available (then reason says why).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why value is None; or, with indicative = true, the caveat on the value.

indicative.title: Indicative
indicative.description: True for a Cornish-Fisher figure whose expansion is not monotone on [-3.5, 3.5], or that differs from the historical figure by more than 50% of it: the value is shown, as an indication only (reason says which).

band.description: Bootstrap band; None when none is shown.

band_quality.title: Band Quality
band_quality.description: validated: the band covered about its nominal level on simulated normal data. approximate: it covered less (it tends to be narrow). None without a band.

band_reason.title: Band Reason
band_reason.description: Why band is None although value is not; None otherwise.

tail_count.title: Tail Count
tail_count.description: Observations with a loss at or beyond this method's VaR at this level; None when the figure is not available.

expected_tail_obs.title: Expected Tail Obs
expected_tail_obs.description: Observations expected in the tail: n x (1 - level).

TailFigureInfo.title: TailFigureInfo
TailFigureInfo.description: One VaR or CVaR figure: one method, one measure, one confidence level.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the horizon has no figures; None when ok.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: Same order as TailRiskSection.figures; the 95% rows exist for monthly and quarterly horizons only.

TailHorizon.title: TailHorizon
TailHorizon.description:
The tail risk figures of one horizon (one day, one month or one quarter).

Statuses: ``ok``; ``insufficient_data`` (fewer than 12 complete periods); ``failed`` (the
periodic returns have no usable tail statistic). A horizon that is not ok holds no part.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: Frequency of the series; the figures are at this horizon.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: Every figure: levels in the order VaR 99%, CVaR 97.5%, then (monthly only) VaR 95% and CVaR 95%; within a level historical, Gaussian, Cornish-Fisher.

by_horizon.title: By Horizon
by_horizon.description: The figures of every horizon the series supports, in the order daily, monthly, quarterly (daily only for a daily series). The horizon that equals `frequency` repeats the top-level figures exactly. Absent (not null) for a section that is not ok, or in reports made before this field existed.

TailRiskSection.title: TailRiskSection
TailRiskSection.description:
VaR and CVaR by three methods, with bootstrap bands.

Statuses: ``ok``; ``insufficient_data`` (fewer than 12 returns); ``failed`` (the series has no
usable tail statistic, for example it is constant).

mean.title: Mean
mean.description: Sample mean of the periodic simple returns.

std.title: Std
std.description: Sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of the returns.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap
bootstrap.description: iid for monthly and quarterly series; stationary block bootstrap for daily series.

mean_block_length.title: Mean Block Length
mean_block_length.description: Mean block length of the stationary bootstrap; None for the iid bootstrap.

band_level.title: Band Level
band_level.description: Coverage of the bands (0.9 is a 90% band).

TailSeriesStats.title: TailSeriesStats
TailSeriesStats.description: The series behind the figures and the bootstrap settings.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display name of the instrument (a sub-asset class line).

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Yahoo ticker; None for a USD cash instrument.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Target weight as a decimal fraction.

TargetWeightRow.title: TargetWeightRow
TargetWeightRow.description: One instrument and its target weight.

name.title: Name
name.description: Company name when its metadata is already cached.

n.title: N
n.description: Trading days after the factor file's last date.

compounded_return.title: Compounded Return
compounded_return.description: Raw (not excess) compounded return over those days; None if n = 0 or a price is missing.

UncoveredTail.title: UncoveredTail
UncoveredTail.description: Price dates after the last factor date (M2 step 6). Never part of any statistic.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is not 'ok'.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Yahoo ticker of the world proxy.

hac_lags.title: Hac Lags
hac_lags.description: Newey-West lags of both regressions; null if none.

n_not_in_benchmark.title: N Not In Benchmark
n_not_in_benchmark.description: Rows of the analysis sample with no usable ACWI return.

acwi_first_date.title: Acwi First Date
acwi_first_date.description: First date of the ACWI price history used; null if there is none.

acwi_last_date.title: Acwi Last Date
acwi_last_date.description: Last date of the ACWI price history used; null if there is none.

acwi_note.title: Acwi Note
acwi_note.description: Set when the ACWI refresh failed: where the cached history ends, or why there is none.

audit_warnings.title: Audit Warnings
audit_warnings.description: Warnings of the ACWI price audit (M1.4).

world.description: Against the world: ACWI, excess of RF.

us_market.description: Against the US market, same days.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: World beta against the US market beta: about_the_same when the two 95% intervals overlap, otherwise higher or lower (a reading of the intervals, not a test).

comparison_text.title: Comparison Text
comparison_text.description: The plain reading of the comparison.

europe.description: The same quick beta against the Europe proxy (IEUR, stand-in for MSCI Europe), with its own status and reason; null when it was not computed. The section status is that of the ACWI fields above, so a failed Europe block never changes it.

WorldBetaSection.title: WorldBetaSection
WorldBetaSection.description: The quick beta against ACWI next to the beta against the US market, on the same days.
